nodes.label: Lunifer Cloudflare Worker
nodes.rationale: Hosts wearable integrations and APNs pushes without requiring Firebase Blaze.

nodes.label: Vendored FeedbackPulse
nodes.rationale: Local Swift package avoids upstream availability dependency and permits compatibility fixes.

nodes.label: Numeric feedback ID decoding
nodes.rationale: Successful API submissions return numeric feedback_id; String decoding caused false error.

nodes.label: Platform floor compatibility
nodes.rationale: Upstream iOS 14 floor conflicts with iOS 15-only alert API; local floor raised to iOS 16.

nodes.label: REST request compatibility
nodes.rationale: API requires top-level app_type and app_version; omission caused HTTP 400.

nodes.label: Adaptive outcomes Firestore sync
nodes.rationale: Local bandit outcomes round-trip to Firestore for reinstall and device-change continuity; alarmInferences is not replayed for training.

nodes.label: Apple Watch measured sleep
nodes.rationale: HealthKit provides retrospective measured sleep, not target recommendations.

nodes.label: Google Calendar least privilege
nodes.rationale: Combine calendar read-only scopes with Google authentication to avoid duplicate consent prompts; discover selected shared calendars.

nodes.label: Outlook separate PKCE calendar authorization
nodes.rationale: Graph calendar scopes mixed into Firebase Microsoft OIDC produce rejected credentials, so calendar consent follows authentication separately.

nodes.label: Passive morning routine estimator
nodes.rationale: Collection is wired but no UI currently surfaces its recommendation.

nodes.label: Permanent sleep history
nodes.rationale: Wearable nights have priority over motion backup to preserve accurate completed nights.

nodes.label: Sleep fit wake timing safety rewards
nodes.norm_label: sleep fit wake timing safety rewards
nodes.rationale: Snooze and manual overrides are excluded from training eligibility.

nodes.label: SIL Open Font License 1.1
nodes.rationale: Fonts may be bundled with software when copyright and license are retained; fonts may not be sold alone.

nodes.label: Derived ambient volume only
nodes.rationale: Audio is never recorded, stored, or transmitted; derived volume values support sleep detection.

nodes.label: On-device calendar processing
nodes.rationale: Calendar events calculate alarms and commute; no calendar editing, server event storage, advertising, or sale.

nodes.label: Informational estimates and alarm disclaimer
nodes.rationale: Recommendations are not medical advice; alarms and data accuracy are not guaranteed.

nodes.label: Adaptive reward weights
nodes.rationale: Sleep fit 50 percent, wake timing 40 percent, safety 10 percent.

nodes.label: Four-step alarm baseline cascade
nodes.rationale: First event tomorrow, weekday event pattern, recorded wake average, then 8 AM fallback.

nodes.label: Minimal manual input
nodes.rationale: Keep onboarding short and prefer passive collection so the experience feels seamless.
